summary: Agent Smith is on the phone in Room 1313 when the line clicks dead on his end. Reacting to the silence, he reports the location of whoever was on the other end, stating that they are on the eighth floor.

what_changes.before: On a call whose status is unknown
what_changes.after: Has located the target on the eighth floor
what_changes.evidence: Eighth floor.  They're on the eighth floor.

event_hint.one_line: Smith's contact is cut off, but he relays the target's location on the eighth floor.
